comment: C-first source-based correction after attempt3 confirmed the +7 wand is in slot p and the levelport arrival. The zap direction unlocks the door, the next movement opens it, and four more north steps leave the first room; no extra space belongs between those actions. The second door is opened from a cardinally adjacent square in the same way. The route ends on ordinary floor adjacent to the generated altar at display coordinate (25,13), then repeatedly plays a 127-charge drum. Keep only if C reaches music.c:do_earthquake ALTAR -> pray.c:desecrate_altar.

segments.comment: C-first corrected route for music.c:do_earthquake -> pray.c:desecrate_altar. The first route reached a locked door before the source-mapped altar. This independently reruns the selected level seed, wishes a charged wand of opening before travel, opens both observed locked doors, reaches the ordinary generated altar at map coordinate (25,13), steps one square away, then wishes a charged drum of earthquake and plays it repeatedly. Keep only if C reaches the ALTAR arm and desecrate_altar.
